summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing an intimation of participation in a scheduled investor conference organized by Bank of America on June 5, 2026, in Hyderabad. The filing is a routine disclosure under SEBI listing regulations for an analyst/institutional investor meeting. No special situation such as acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, not triggering any special-situation category.
